must_pass.name: title_integrity
must_pass.test: provided headline exact string; no invented extra words

must_pass.name: source_fidelity
must_pass.test: uploaded protagonists, vehicle and key evidence remain recognizable when requested
must_pass.repair: re-edit from original, no unsupported recreation claim

must_pass.name: platform_ratio
must_pass.test: actual image width/height ratio matches selected preset

must_pass.name: full_bleed
must_pass.test: no unwanted gray backing, internal frame or platform screenshots

must_pass.name: hierarchy
must_pass.test: at thumbnail scale subject + one key message legible
must_pass.repair: shorten *suggested* text only; preserve user exact title

must_pass.name: rights_truth
must_pass.test: no fabricated game facts or implied Rockstar endorsement

test_protocol: Same subject, same platform, 3 with skill and 3 without; use random order, blind rate, log actual generations and costs. Scores are internal heuristics, not observed CTR.

de_ai_audit.exceptions: 用户明确指定文字、真实信息指向、功能性分割和可读性需要优先
de_ai_audit.result: 只有能观察到的元素才能报告，AI感为主观体验，不能把风格评分声称为客观CTR提升
